name: Physical-risk hazard dictionary (design f4; main outcomes Y3d, Y4d, Y4s, Y4r under A20)
source: docs/design.md f4 and config/parameters.json text.physical_risk_dictionary (OD-11, decided 2026-11-07). The design's 16 terms in the design's order, minus bare 'heat', plus 'extreme heat' (A20).
amendment: A17 (matching rule); A20 (OD-11 decided by a pre-set rule: 'heat' dropped, 'extreme heat' added)

matching_rule.unit: the paragraph (or split piece) text as stored in data/interim/paragraphs.csv
matching_rule.boundaries: whole words: the character before and after a match is not a letter or digit
matching_rule.plurals: regular plural -s/-es only, for count nouns (floods, storms, droughts, heatwaves, wildfires, inundations, rainfalls, extreme temperatures, sea levels); no other inflection
matching_rule.multi_word_terms: a space in a term matches one or more spaces or hyphens (sea-level, water-stress); 'heatwave' also matches 'heat wave' and 'heat-wave'
matching_rule.not_matched: verb and adjective forms that are not in the list, e.g. 'flooded', 'floodplain', 'stormwater', 'water-stressed', 'heated', 'heating', 'eroded'. Recall is not measured (A20); adding any form requires an amendment
matching_rule.tag: a paragraph is hazard-tagged if at least one term matches; Y3d = tagged / all scored narrative paragraphs, with no climate filter (A20)

od11_bare_heat: Decided by a pre-set rule without looking at any count (A20, 2026-11-17): bare 'heat' is dropped (mostly process heat in kiln, furnace, brewery and power-plant reports, e.g. 'waste heat recovery'); 'extreme heat' is added; 'heatwave' and 'extreme temperature' are kept; 'high temperature' is not added (mostly process language).
precision_check: A20: 100 tagged snippets checked by one external person; see docs/amendments.md
